title: [Subcontracting] Assign worksheet suggestions to existing purchase orders
summary: Subcontracting worksheet users can now assign suggestions to existing open purchase orders instead of always creating new orders, with filtering and validation for purchase order compatibility.
key_points: Adds purchase order targeting to requisition lines with compatibility checks for vendor, customer, shipping, currency and purchasing code
Worksheet gains actions for assigning purchase orders, clearing targets, and showing assigned orders
Reference semantics changed: Ref. Order Type now indicates Purchase with empty Ref. Order No., while Prod. Order No. tracks the production order
Requisition Line Management codeunit removes target if action message changes from New
Comprehensive test coverage with 27 new tests for assignment, validation, and edge cases
quote: Users can now attach a new subcontracting suggestion in the Subcontracting Worksheet to an existing open purchase order.
